title: Nirva, which plans to launch a wearable AI personal companion that offers relationship advice and more, raised $25M, bringing its total funding to $33M (Will Maddox/Axios)
summary: Will Maddox / Axios: Nirva, which plans to launch a wearable AI personal companion that offers relationship advice and more, raised $25M, bringing its total funding to $33M — Nirva, a startup developing wearable AI personal companions, raised $25 million ahead of its November product launch, CEO Wei Lyu tells Axios Pro exclusively.
